llm_judge_reasons: Critical command syntax error: The command array ['code', '--list-extensions', '|', 'grep', 'undefined_publisher.test'] will fail at runtime because pipe '|' and 'grep' are treated as literal arguments to 'code' command, not as shell operators
The getter get_vm_command_line requires 'shell': true in config to execute shell pipelines, but this parameter is missing from the evaluator config
Without proper shell execution, the command will not pipe output to grep, causing the verification to fail even if the extension is correctly installed
The semantic intent is correct (check if extension is in the installed list), but the implementation will not work due to incorrect command syntax
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Option 1: Add 'shell': true to the result config and format command as a single string: {"type": "vm_command_line", "command": "code --list-extensions | grep undefined_publisher.test", "shell": true}

Option 2: Simplify to use only 'code --list-extensions' command without grep: {"type": "vm_command_line", "command": ["code", "--list-extensions"]} and rely on the 'contain' metric to check if 'undefined_publisher.test' is in the output
Recommended: Use Option 2 as it's simpler and doesn't require shell execution, reducing potential security and portability issues
